title: Conditional hook usage
description: Only shows draft controls when the panel is expanded.
issue_title: Hook is called conditionally
issue_description: React hooks must run in the same order on every render, so calling useState inside a branch breaks the rules of hooks.
issue_suggestion: Call hooks unconditionally at the top level of the component.

title: State update during render
description: Computes a default tab when the component renders.
issue_title: State is updated while rendering
issue_description: Calling setState during render can trigger render loops and breaks React's render purity.
issue_suggestion: Initialize lazily or update selection in an effect.

title: Object URL cleanup
description: Previews an uploaded image file.
issue_title: Created object URLs are never revoked
issue_description: Each file change allocates a new object URL that stays alive unless revoked.
issue_suggestion: Revoke the old object URL in the effect cleanup.

title: Checkbox binding
description: Renders a controlled checkbox for email preferences.
issue_title: Checkbox uses value instead of checked
issue_description: Checkbox state is controlled through the checked prop, not the value prop.
issue_suggestion: Bind the checkbox with checked.

title: Button accidentally submits a form
description: Adds a reset action next to a form submit button.
issue_title: Button defaults to submit
issue_description: A button inside a form submits the form unless its type is set explicitly.
issue_suggestion: Mark non-submit buttons as type='button'.

title: Abort stale profile requests
description: Loads account details when the account id changes.
issue_title: Request lifecycle is not cancelled
issue_description: A slower response for an old account can resolve after unmount or after a newer request and overwrite fresh state.
issue_suggestion: Abort or ignore stale requests in the effect cleanup.

title: External link security
description: Opens documentation in a new tab.
issue_title: target=_blank is missing rel protection
issue_description: Opening a new tab without rel attributes can expose the opener to the new page.
issue_suggestion: Add rel='noreferrer noopener' to the link.

title: Random keys in a list
description: Renders notification rows.
issue_title: Keys change on every render
issue_description: Random keys force React to remount every row each render and lose any preserved state.
issue_suggestion: Use a stable identifier from the data.

title: Mutating state with splice
description: Removes a row from a table stored in local state.
issue_title: State array is mutated in place
issue_description: splice changes the existing array reference, so React may not detect the update correctly.
issue_suggestion: Create a new array when removing an item.

title: Effect dependency on a fresh object
description: Loads results whenever the current status filter changes.
issue_title: Effect reruns every render
issue_description: The filters object is recreated on each render, so the dependency is always different.
issue_suggestion: Depend on the stable primitive value or create the object inside the effect.

title: Side effect inside render
description: Sets the page title from a component prop.
issue_title: DOM side effect runs during render
issue_description: Rendering should stay pure; mutating document.title belongs in an effect.
issue_suggestion: Move the title update into useEffect.

title: Accessible label wiring
description: Shows a labeled text field for a profile form.
issue_title: Label is not associated with the input
issue_description: Without htmlFor, assistive technologies do not know which input the label describes.
issue_suggestion: Connect the label to the input id.

title: Controlled select misuse
description: Shows a selected country in a dropdown.
issue_title: Selection is controlled on each option
issue_description: In React, a controlled select should use the value prop on the select element rather than selected on options.
issue_suggestion: Control the current value from the select itself.

title: File input control
description: Lets the user choose a file to upload.
issue_title: File inputs cannot be controlled by value
issue_description: Browsers do not allow React to programmatically set the value of a file input.
issue_suggestion: Remove the value prop and read files from the change event instead.

title: Mutating prop-derived state
description: Keeps a local editable copy of a tag list.
issue_title: Local state mutates the original prop array
issue_description: Because the initial state shares the same array reference as tags, push mutates parent-owned data too.
issue_suggestion: Copy the array when initializing and updating local state.

title: Stale interval closure
description: Counts elapsed seconds while a timer is running.
issue_title: Interval callback captures stale state
issue_description: The effect runs once, so the callback always sees the initial seconds value and never increments past 1.
issue_suggestion: Use a functional state update inside the interval callback.

title: Loading state not reset on failure
description: Saves a profile form and shows a loading indicator.
issue_title: Loading state can stay stuck after an error
issue_description: If fetch rejects, setLoading(false) never runs and the button remains in a loading state.
issue_suggestion: Reset loading in a finally block.

title: Window event listener in render
description: Tracks the current scroll position.
issue_title: Listener is attached on every render
issue_description: Adding DOM listeners during render leaks handlers and breaks React's purity expectations.
issue_suggestion: Register and clean up the listener inside useEffect.

title: Null prop access
description: Shows the signed-in user's display name.
issue_title: Component crashes when user is not loaded
issue_description: The first render may pass null or undefined before authentication data arrives.
issue_suggestion: Guard against missing data before reading nested fields.

title: Imperative navigation in render
description: Redirects the user away when access is denied.
issue_title: Navigation side effect runs during render
issue_description: Triggering navigation inside render can cause repeated redirects and breaks render purity.
issue_suggestion: Move navigation into an effect that reacts to canView changes.

title: Unstable default object prop
description: Applies optional filter settings to a product list.
issue_title: Default object creates a new dependency every render
issue_description: The inline default {} is a fresh object each render, so the effect reruns even when callers pass nothing.
issue_suggestion: Use a stable shared default object.

title: Form submit handler ignores await
description: Submits a login form asynchronously.
issue_title: Async submit does not await login
issue_description: Errors from the login promise can escape the handler and later state changes may race ahead of authentication.
issue_suggestion: Await the async login operation.
